items.html: And their main purpose is to give a beard to ZA. And his beard is only nine Tikunim; and with them it is completed to the thirteen Tikunim of the beard, also for him. And the main of this discourse has been explained in the explanation of Va'yaavor and the thirteen attributes of mercy; see there. And in brief we shall say that the beard of Arich Anpin is drawn from the Hochma of the Moach Stimaa within it; but the beard of ZA is drawn from the Daat itself of ZA. See what I have explained in the matter of the sin of Cain and Abel, when they offered wool and linen.
